entities.name: Babolax
entities.description: Goblin foreman on the Cauldron project for the Izzet, killed by Teysa Karlov.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Orzhov leader who interrogated and killed Babolax.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: Izzet magelord Babolax was sent in place of.

events.summary: Babolax is sent to an audience with Teysa Karlov instead of Zomaj Hauc, bringing a bam-stick as a gift.
events.quote: He brought a gift to Teysa: a fully loaded bam-stick

events.summary: Teysa questions Babolax in her verity circle.
events.quote: Teysa put him into her verity circle and asked questions about the Cauldron

events.summary: Teysa kills Babolax with the bam-stick as a warning to Hauc.
events.quote: she killed Babolax by burning his head off with the bam-stick as a warning for Hauc

relations.note: Burned his head off with a bam-stick
relations.quote: she killed Babolax by burning his head off with the bam-stick as a warning for Hauc
in the service of the Izzet guild on Ravnica
